column1: # GIGANTIC upload_manifest.tsv — secretome / STEP_2-filter_secretome
# Publishes the per-species SECRETOME tables produced by this workflow: the
# final collaborator-facing deliverable of the secretome subproject. Each file
# is one per-species subset of proteins that pass the user-authored secretome
# filter manifest, after the evidence table has been augmented with derived
# columns (cysteine count, Pfam max-hits-per-accession), orthogroup membership
# + model-species orthologs (from the canonical BLOCK_orthohmm_GIGANTIC run:
# 202,994 orthogroups / 1,375,926 members), and BLASTP top-10 NCBI nr hits.
# Filenames carry the run label: <phyloname>_secretome_NNN[_<name>].tsv
# (e.g. Homo_sapiens_secretome_001_moroz_strict.tsv).
# Mechanics: source_path is relative to the workflow-RUN_* directory holding
# this manifest. The shared helper (../../server/ai/update_upload_to_server.py,
# invoked by the subproject-root RUN-update_upload_to_server.sh) publishes the
# newest RUN per step into
# upload_to_server/STEP_2-filter_secretome/workflow-RUN_*/.
# This is a COPYME template; it travels with the workflow into each
# workflow-RUN_* dir, where the helper picks it up.
source_path
# ----- Validated filter manifest snapshot (script 001) -----
OUTPUT_pipeline/1-output/*_validated_manifest.json
column6: Snapshot of the user-authored secretome filter manifest applied in this run (the exact filter clauses that defined "secreted" for every species).
